campaign_trend.name: Campaign Daily Performance — Trend
campaign_trend.description: One row per campaign per day. Use for spotting day-over-day changes in spend, CPA or conversions.
campaign_trend.query: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, date, impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, conversion_value, ctr, cpc, cvr, cpa, roas FROM campaigns_daily WHERE date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s ORDER BY campaign_id, date

campaign_comparison.name: Campaign Period Performance — Comparison
campaign_comparison.description: One aggregated row per campaign for the period. Use for ranking campaigns by spend or CPA.
campaign_comparison.query: SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(conversion_value) AS conversion_value, SUM(clicks)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr, SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc, SUM(conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cvr, SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(conversions), 0) AS cpa, SUM(conversion_value) / NULLIF(SUM(cost), 0) AS roas FROM campaigns_daily WHERE date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s GROUP BY campaign_id, campaign_name ORDER BY cost DESC

ad_group_trend.name: Ad Group Daily Performance — Trend
ad_group_trend.description: One row per ad group per day. Use for spotting which ad group drove a campaign-level change.
ad_group_trend.query: SELECT campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, date, impressions, clicks, cost, conversions, conversion_value, all_conversions, all_conversion_value, ctr, cpc, cvr, cpa, roas, search_impression_share, search_rank_lost_is FROM ad_groups_daily WHERE date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s ORDER BY campaign_id, ad_group_id, date

ad_group_comparison.name: Ad Group Period Performance — Comparison
ad_group_comparison.description: One aggregated row per ad group for the period. Use for ranking ad groups by spend or CPA within a campaign.
ad_group_comparison.query: SELECT campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_group_name, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(cost) AS cost, SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(conversion_value) AS conversion_value, SUM(all_conversions) AS all_conversions, SUM(all_conversion_value) AS all_conversion_value, SUM(clicks)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(impressions), 0) AS ctr, SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cpc, SUM(conversions) / NULLIF(SUM(clicks), 0) AS cvr, SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(conversions), 0) AS cpa, SUM(conversion_value) / NULLIF(SUM(cost), 0) AS roas FROM ad_groups_daily WHERE date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s GROUP BY campaign_id, ad_group_id, ad_group_name ORDER BY cost DESC
